notes:
Radio's filters are more consistently Indian now: only the Sports filter still shows stations from around the world - every other filter (Music, News, Devotional, AIR, Community, and the rest) now sticks to Indian stations and stations in Indian languages, even ones based outside India. TV's own filters are unaffected.

Settings and Sound effects now show what each option actually does right on the screen, not just to screen readers.

Nicer empty screens, smoother filter switching, and an on-brand "NEW" badge color.
